title: ArcBuilder occupied MOVE reuses deconstruction material flows
assumptions: Low/base/high are illustrative 100/1000/10000 displaced stone blocks per player-day, 1/5/20 participants, 100/500/2500 displaced blocks per active hour and 1/2/4 active hours. Not telemetry, a daily cap or a measured practical rate.
Separate units: vault, tokens, player XP, cobblestone items and planned durability points. No conversion or native random-drop expectation is invented.
MOVE previously rejected occupied targets. The existing DECONSTRUCT then MOVE route has the same drops and wear for identical targets and tools; the new path merely combines it.
Tool-free permission, no-Silk-Touch drops, native Fortune, inventory capacity, safety, protection and hourly/change limits are unchanged. Creative has no item or durability output.

Source blocks conserve exact states; displaced targets are removed once. Frozen rewards and exact preimages share the existing journal/rollback/recovery transaction; undo consumes rewards and preserves spent wear.

MOVE does not emit construction rewards. Current SELL and future SELL-to-contract transition remain unchanged. No hypothetical SELL/SHADOW income, accumulation time or all-account farm rate is asserted.

Existing hourly allowance H is unchanged, but a simple N-block source with N occupied non-overlapping targets costs 3N counted changes via DECONSTRUCT then MOVE and 2N via combined MOVE: floor(H/3) versus floor(H/2) targets. This can raise the accounting ceiling by 1.5x, without increasing drops per removed block; actual throughput is unmeasured.
